notes: When you tell Crisp what you don’t want, it now listens. “Sharpen it without upscaling” or “sharpen it but keep the resolution” gives you a light sharpen at the same size, where before it either enlarged the video or said it couldn’t. “Upscale it without more detail” runs a plain upscale, “don’t crop it, add more detail” does the upscale you asked for instead of asking what you want, and “sharpen it and upscale it” keeps the sharpen.
